LESSON: LETTER FORMATION

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: Writing
Topic 3.1: Letter formation
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Letter formation, part of Writing in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: What can we do with letters of the alphabet to make them appear good? 2. What games relating to letter sounds do you like playing?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Letter formation together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Integrity is enhanced as the learner utilizes paint and modeling clay, plasticine or dough prudently even without teacher’s

supervision.

● Social justice is enhanced as the learner while doing activities surrounding letter writing with others share resources to all

equitably.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Personal hygiene awareness is enhanced as the leaner washes hands with soap and clean water after tiding up their coloring,

painting and modelling items.
